name: Easy Discount
author: Galaxy Weblinks

sections.description:
Easy Discount is a simple WooCommerce plugin that adds a bulk purchase discount based on the subtotal. The discount is activated when a customer buys at least a minimum quantity of items. It also displays a customizable discount message on product pages to inform customers of the bulk discount offer.

Key Features:
– Adds a bulk purchase discount to the WooCommerce checkout based on the subtotal.
– Discount is activated when a customer purchases at least the minimum required quantity of items.
– Customizable discount message displayed on product pages.
– Admin settings page to configure the discount message, minimum quantity, and discount percentage.

Here’s a link to the documentation for the plugin. This will help you learn more about its features and how to use it.
Documentation

For any feedback or queries regarding this plugin, please contact our Support team.

Compatibility

This plugin is compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

sections.installation:
1. Upload the easy-discount folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce -> Discount Settings to configure the discount message, minimum quantity, and discount percentage.
sections.faq:
How do I set the discount amount?

The discount percentage and minimum quantity can be configured in the WooCommerce settings page. Once a customer adds enough items to their cart (based on the minimum quantity), the discount is applied to the subtotal.

How does the bulk discount work?

The discount is applied based on the total quantity of items in the cart. Once the quantity threshold is reached, the discount is calculated and subtracted from the cart subtotal.

How can I change the discount message?

You can customize the discount message on the settings page, where you can enter a message that will be displayed on product pages. The default message is “Buy 3 or more items to get a discount!”

Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, this plugin is compatible with most themes that support WooCommerce. It adds a custom discount message to product pages and applies a discount at checkout.
